make_or_buy_basis: Commodity navigation and communications devices are installed as individually traceable modules on the train network.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: halogen/fire-rated cable where required, IP sealing, bonding, and label protection
material_spec.form_factor: cabinet, harness, connector, sensor, bracket, antenna, and label kit
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail electronics specification plus project EMC, IP, and fire evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: LV/data harness, cabinet, sensor, antenna, and trainline kit
material_spec.nominal_section: connector, bend-radius, service-loop, and mounting envelope frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: serialised equipment CoC, firmware/config record, harness batch, and continuity record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: SOURCE supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Moxa anchors computing/network hardware only; the independent safety controller, navigation sensors, HMI and safety relays need exact part selection and safety allocation.
supplier_anchor.localisation: OSR software remains portable behind published I/O, TSN/Ethernet and update interfaces; alternate compute/network hardware must pass timing, safety allocation, EMC, environmental, cybersecurity and whole-train hardware-in-loop tests.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: EN 50155 railway computers, Ethernet switches and wireless gateways
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.

title: navigation, balise, 5G, LoRa, GNSS, IMU, and roof-antenna kit
